title: Customer Reviews Technical Reference
readerIntent: Understand customer-review ownership, lifecycle, moderation, and integration.
priorKnowledge: Understand customer identity, products/content, workflows, and publishing.
summary: Customer reviews use owned schemas and services for submission, rating, moderation, publication, and integration; they do not write Product or customer identity records directly.

sections.heading: Capability ownership
items: A review capability owns review submissions, rating, moderation state, eligibility evidence, abuse decisions, publication, removal, and aggregate projections.
Product, content, service, order, or partner modules retain ownership of the reviewed subject and expose stable references through authenticated contracts.
Profile remains customer identity authority; review data stores only governed references and display projections rather than copied credentials.

sections.heading: Submission and moderation lifecycle
items: Submission validates tenant, authenticated customer, subject, rating scale, required content, locale, verified relationship policy, duplicate rule, limits, and consent.
The review enters configured pending, approved, rejected, flagged, published, withdrawn, or removed states through explicit manual and automatic moderation actions.
Workflow may coordinate human and automated moderation, while the review service owns state transitions and the subject module never edits review persistence directly.

sections.heading: Privacy, abuse, and presentation
items: Mask customer identity according to policy, strip unsafe markup and metadata, scan governed media references, limit size and frequency, and preserve appeal and audit evidence.
Spam, fraud, harassment, prohibited content, coordinated rating, and provider classifications are signals; final automated or manual action follows documented policy.
Published display and aggregates are derived, locale-aware projections. Cache and search can be rebuilt and never override moderation or deletion authority.

sections.heading: Operations and verification
items: Test eligible and ineligible customers, wrong tenant, duplicate, invalid rating, boundary text/media, malicious markup, rate limits, moderation, appeal, withdrawal, and deletion.
Test subject deletion, identity masking, aggregate rebuild, cache/search failure, workflow retry, concurrent moderation, provider outage, retention, privacy request, and regression.
Monitor submissions, moderation age, rejection and abuse categories, appeal, publication lag, aggregate drift, provider health, and reviewer workload with bounded labels.

sections.heading: Partner implementation guidance
items: Configure rating scale, eligible subjects, verified relationship, duplicate window, moderation actions, languages, display identity, retention, media, and abuse providers.
Extend through owned schemas, services, workflows, and adapters; do not embed moderation authority in frontend widgets or Product records.
Document customer submission, moderator operation, business policy, developer extension, privacy, incident handling, accessibility, and known limitations.

sections.heading: Contract
items: Tenant, customer/owner, subject type/reference, rating scale, title/body/media references, locale, status, timestamps, and version.
Eligibility, duplicate policy, verified relationship, moderation workflow, abuse/spam controls, masking, retention, and appeal.
Published aggregate projections remain derived; Product/content modules retain subject ownership.
Test unauthorized/cross-tenant, invalid rating, duplicate, moderation, publication, removal, aggregation, privacy, abuse, performance, and regression.
